protocol.name: rediwm_titlebar_tabs_v1
protocol.description:
An application publishes the tabs of its window and the compositor paints them in the window's titlebar. The compositor draws and hit-tests the strip; the application owns the tabs and the user's actions come back as events. The strip only shows while the compositor draws the window's titlebar (server-side decorations). An application that has to draw its own titlebar draws its own tabs.
Private to rediwm and its bundled applications.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Objects already created from it stay valid.

request.name: get_titlebar_tabs

description.summary: create the tab strip for a toplevel's surface

request.description: The surface is, or will become, the surface of an xdg_toplevel. Like the KDE decoration manager this can be sent before the shell role is assigned. The strip is empty until the first commit.

entry.name: already_constructed
entry.summary: the surface already has a tab strip

interface.name: rediwm_titlebar_tabs_v1
interface.description: State is double-buffered: add_tab, set_selected and the like build a pending strip that replaces the shown one on commit. The pending state is empty again after every commit, so each commit describes the whole strip.

entry.name: duplicate_id
entry.summary: two tabs in one commit have the same id

entry.name: unknown_selected
entry.summary: the selected id is not among the tabs

entry.name: too_many_tabs
entry.summary: more than 128 tabs in one commit

entry.name: invalid_id
entry.summary: tab ids must not be zero

entry.name: modified
entry.summary: the tab has unsaved changes; shown as a leading bullet

description.summary: remove the strip and destroy the object

request.name: add_tab

description.summary: append a tab to the pending strip

request.description: Tabs show in the order they are added. Titles longer than 256 bytes are cut; a title that is not valid UTF-8 is replaced. The icon name is accepted and ignored in this version; every tab shows the application's icon.

arg.name: id
arg.summary: the application's id for the tab, not zero

request.name: set_selected

description.summary: select a tab in the pending strip

request.description: Required before a commit that adds tabs, and it must name one of them.

request.name: commit
request.description: Replaces the shown strip. A commit with no tabs removes the strip and the titlebar goes back to showing the window's title.

event.name: select
event.description: The compositor does not change the selected tab itself: the application changes its state and commits the result.

description.summary: the user asked to close a tab
the user pressed the new tab button
